runningTitle: Microsoft Power Automate for End Users
subtitle: Two-day course book
blurb: Collect, report, remind, approve and release: automate a training coordinator's routine with automated, instant and scheduled cloud flows, Copilot and solutions.
author: Asraf Jaafar Sidik
trademark: Microsoft, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, Power Platform, Copilot, Excel, Outlook, Teams, Forms, OneDrive and SharePoint are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies. This book is independent training material and is not published or endorsed by Microsoft.
backCover: This book accompanies the two-day Microsoft Power Automate for End Users course. It follows one training coordinator's routine, from saving email attachments and sending an Excel summary, through weekly reminders and a Forms approval, to a filtered capstone flow, a Copilot-planned design and a solution ready to move. Every chapter pairs short notes with copy-ready names and expressions you can use during the session and back at your desk.
